column7: draw -- provenance of every value of conversational-v5 (References #2029). `source` is a named lexical source, or rule-number-draw for a drawn two-digit number; `source_sha256` is the sha256 of that source file; `draw` is sha256(SEED|slot) with SEED = uor-r4-panel-v5-2026-10-09, the digest that selects the value under the rule in scripts/panel_v5_draw.py. The source line, the pool index, the pool size and the rule for every row are in docs/labs/panel-freeze-2026-10-09/provenance-draw.tsv. The sentence frames, the keys and the scene catalogue are authored in scripts/panel_v5_draw.py; they are not values. Every reply phrasing in the forbid list of an impossible-action unknowable row is authored there too.
